description: Ausgrid Community Electricity Data 2014 to 2022 is a dataset listed in Maitland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ausgrid. Ausgrid is providing the following data on electricity consumption within Maitland local government areas (LGA). Average electricity consumption by geographic area can vary significantly due to a number of factors. Coverage: Maitland, New South Wales. The portal files it under LIVING SUSTAINABLY. Its keywords are electricity, energy, CO2, ausgrid, NSW. The portal shows 33 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-maitland-nsw-gov-au-portal.
